title: "Put <stigma> on E" steps are never completed, so Lv 27/32/37 milestones stay "Missed" forever
repro: User save -> Lv 28 -> Next up 'Equip Illusive Clone' -> Equipped (same at 32 Swift Contract, 37 Savage Fang). Level to 45. g27:1, g32:1, g37:1 are still unticked and g27/g32/g37 show 'Missed'. Next up skips eput items (stepsOf: it.eput), and opening/closing the Build drawer ('closing this panel marks it done') does not tick them either (polish/qa3/dr2.js).
fix: In stTickClick also tick the slot's eput item (g27:1/g32:1/g37:1) when the equip is confirmed, or tick the pending eput items when the drawer closes after its NEW note; add a migration that ticks eput for slots already equipped.

title: Optional steps keep milestones "Missed" (shown at the top of Basic) and never reach Next up
repro: Journey to 45: g22 (Krao Cave Expedition), g25 (Supply Requests), g28 (Urugugu Canyon), g35 (Fire Temple) end 'Missed' with only OPTIONAL rows left; Basic lists 'Stigma slot 1 · Missed 15/16' and 'Supply Requests · Missed 8/9' first from Lv 29 on (shots/j-38-basic.png, j-45-basic.png). Next up never offers them (stepsOf drops non-adv optional), yet the Lv 34 'Later' card promises 'Fire Temple · Lv 35 milestone' and nothing appears at 35 (same for Urugugu at 28).
fix: Exclude unticked optional items from the Missed/Cleared/count math (count them only when ticked) and hide them in Basic; don't make a Later card for a milestone whose only remaining non-quest steps are optional. Optionally surface the expedition as an Optional card when the story is level-gated.

title: Skill plan ends at Lv 41; 7 -> 28 points sit 'unplanned' with a link that gives no plan
repro: Journey Lv 42-45: Skills hero shows 'All planned upgrades spent · 28 points unplanned · see Build plan' (shots/j-45-advanced.png). The link jumps to milestone 'Build plan', whose only skill line is the generic 'spend them at each milestone' (shots/buildplan-click.png).
fix: Extend SP_STEPS past Lv 41 from the sourced per-level costs and gates (next levels of the core skills / sourced extras), or, if nothing passes the source bar, say it plainly on the card ('No sourced plan past Lv 41: keep N points for ...') and drop the 'see Build plan' link.

title: Story level-gated with nothing to do: Next up only says 'Level up first'
repro: Lv 28 (Land of Rifts needs 29) and Lv 38-39 (Fafnite's Whereabouts needs 40): every dungeon, stronghold and regional quest at the level is done; Next up shows the gated story card plus 'Later' cards, no source of XP (shots/j-38-basic.png).
fix: When gated and nothing else is open, add one line under the story card listing what is open and verified at that level (daily dungeon from 30, Urugugu 28 / Fire Temple 35 expeditions, strongholds), linked to their milestone rows.

title: '+N more upgrades available now' counts upgrades the points can't buy
repro: Lv 29: '5 pts to spend' and '+31 more upgrades available now'; Lv 30: 8 pts, '+32 more' (shots/j-30-advanced.png).
fix: Count only what the remaining points cover ('+2 more you can afford now'), or word it 'N more open at your level'.

title: Stigma 'Coming up X of Y spent' total jumps from 15 to 90 after equipping slot 2
repro: User save Lv 27-28: 'COMING UP 4 of 15 spent'; after Equipped at 28: '5 of 90 spent' (journey.log).
fix: Compute the total from the full plan (all planned slots incl. not-yet-learned stigmas) so the denominator is stable, or drop the 'of Y'.

title: Journey 'Quest done · next quest ›' is a dead button after the Altgard story ends
repro: Lv 45 after Forgotten Commander 'Turned in': the Journey objectives still show the green 'Quest done · next quest ›'; clicking it changes nothing (polish/qa3/qd.js) while Next up says 'Altgard story complete'.
fix: When state.storyEnd === state.quest, replace the button with the same 'Altgard story complete · continue in Reshanta' line.

title: Snoozing the only open regional quest removes the Regional card: no count, no undo in Next up
repro: Lv 30: Regional quests '1 to pick up' -> eye-slash on Her Last Favor -> the card disappears; '1 not in game yet' is shown nowhere in Next up until the next Level up.
fix: Keep a compact Regional card while rqSnz > 0 ('1 not in game yet · Show') with the un-snooze control.

title: Story-gated quest the user sees in game is not offered in Next up (Fight Poison with Poison)
repro: User save at 'Preparations for Restoration': the quest is open in his game, but data gates it on 'A Collective Effort'; Next up hides story-locked quests, the 'In my game' pill exists only in the milestone row (regress soft fail).
fix: List story-locked quests whose rec <= level as a collapsed '+N waiting on the story' row in the Regional card with the same 'In my game' control; re-check this gate's semantics (accepted vs reached) against aion2.gaming.tools.

title: Single-source skill buys appear in Next up as plain actions
repro: Lv 36-41: Next up 'Buy Determination 6 → 7', 'Buy Heightened Sixth Sense 8 → 9' etc. show no label; only the Skills hero adds 'single source (games.gg)'.
fix: Append 'single source' to those cards' subline (same tag as the hero), or stop the plan before them per the 2-source rule.

title: Nine Wonders of Altgard: 2nd Leg zone disagrees with its giver
repro: rq.json/app zone 'Impetusium Square' (allthings list page) but Metabot: giver Tina at Battlescar Mound, turn-in Nornir Assembly, steps at Moslan Forest / Basfelt cliffs; the zone drives the 'near your story step' flag.
fix: Set zone from the giver (Battlescar Mound, as for Pain Unending) via CAMP_ZONE in gen.py, or omit the zone when sources disagree.

title: Sources card repeats '(checked Oct 2026)' and 'Earlier research' in most rows
repro: Sources card, Advanced and Basic (shots/srcCard-advanced.png): 10 of 15 rows carry 'Tips and rules (checked Oct 2026)', 6 carry 'Earlier research'.
fix: Say 'checked Oct 2026' once in the card intro and rename 'Earlier research' to what it backs (or fold it into the matching group).
